stemMd: An ideal spring of constant 200 N/m is compressed by 0.10 m. How much elastic potential energy is stored?
explanationMd: Elastic energy is one half kx squared. Substituting gives 0.5 times 200 times 0.01=1 J. Force kx and energy are different quantities.

distractorRationale.c: This uses displacement linearly instead of squared.
distractorRationale.e: This is the spring force's numerical value.
